name: Asahina Mitsuba
source:
[b]Apostle to the Summit of the World[/b]

A rising idol. She has many fans who have followed her since her early days, and she's been appearing on TV more often lately.

She loves singing, dancing, and talking, and nothing gives her more pleasure than seeing her fans get excited by her activities.

She's still emotionally immature and doesn't fully grasp that her sexuality is being marketed.
